Good To Know

Questions, Answered

Do you come to me, or do I come to you?

Tell us what works best. Many details can be arranged at your home or office — just ask when you request your quote and we will let you know what we can do.

How long does a full detail take?

Most full details run roughly three to five hours depending on the size and condition of the vehicle. We will give you a realistic time estimate when we confirm your quote.

How is pricing decided?

Pricing is based on vehicle size and condition. We always confirm an exact quote before we begin, so there are no surprises.

What types of vehicles do you detail?

Cars, trucks, SUVs, and boats are all welcome. If you are not sure whether we can help with your vehicle, just ask.

How do I book?

Send us your vehicle and the service you want through the quote form or chat, or give us a call. We will confirm the details and lock in a time that works for you.
